title: Hometown Heroes Award Computation and Re-Certification Increase
content:
**Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit — award computation sheet**

1. **When and on what.** The Hometown Heroes award is computed by this rule at verification, at each re-size and at re-certification, on the base loan amount then on the loan file, which becomes the credit's basis.
2. **Award.** The Hometown Heroes award is 0.15 percent of the base loan amount, rounded to the cent, never below 500.00 and never above the program's credit cap. The credit cap is the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit's figure in the Closing Cost Credit award schedule.
3. **Increase on re-certification.** On re-certification the increase is the re-fixed award less the credit's available balance (its award entries less its reduction and application entries), never below zero, rounded to the cent, and it is booked as a further award entry. Where the re-fixed award is not above the available balance, the re-certification books no entry and the balance stands.

### Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Base loan amount | 0.15 percent, to the cent | Floor of 500.00 | Award (before the credit cap) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 250000.00 | 375.00 | raised | 500.00 |
| 412000.00 | 618.00 | not reached | 618.00 |
| 498765.00 | 748.15 | not reached | 748.15 |

The award is then lowered to the program's credit cap if it is above that figure.

| Re-fixed award | Available balance | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 618.00 | 520.00 | increase of 98.00, booked as a further award entry |
| 618.00 | 618.00 | no entry; the balance stands at 618.00 |
| 600.00 | 700.00 | no entry; the balance stands at 700.00 |

The available balance counts the award entries less the reduction and application entries on the credit's ledger; a credit with award entries of 500.00 and 120.00 and a reduction entry of 100.00 has an available balance of 520.00.
